recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, multi-layered group portrait of four young women against a solid, warm-toned background, featuring a distinctive rhinestone-effect display title and clean sans-serif secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via warm color harmony
Textural contrast between matte skin/fabric and sparkling typography
Tight cropping creating intimacy and focus
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact from all subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, arranged in a staggered, overlapping formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's face and the large rhinestone title in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, moves down through the faces in a clockwise spiral, ending on the bottom-right subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid red-brown space in the upper third provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep terracotta/red-brown background providing a warm, unified stage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and pale pink clothing to separate subjects from the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-yellow for the rhinestone text effect.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with medium-value skin tones and high-value highlights on clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and pastels

letterConstructionRules: Glyphs are composed entirely of small, circular dots
Dots are arranged in a grid-like matrix to form letter shapes
Uniform stroke width based on dot diameter
characterSpecificRedesigns: D and R feature rounded outer corners
M has a deep central valley reaching the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a complex, textured display face with a minimalist, functional sans-serif.

preserve: Dotted texture of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the rhinestone/beaded texture of the original title.
Provides the clean, neutral secondary text required for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of four young women in Y2K-era fashion (tank tops, low-rise pants) posed in a tight group against a solid terracotta-red background. Lighting should be soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large title in the top-left corner using a custom dot-matrix/rhinestone effect in gold. Place a smaller, clean white sans-serif subtitle directly underneath it, aligned to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the main title composed of distinct dots?
Are all subjects looking directly at the camera?
Is the background a solid, warm color?
Is the text left-aligned in the upper quadrant?

adjustableVariables: Dot size in the display typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any specific brand logos on clothing
Exact phrasing of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for 4 distinct subjects in the composition
Verify the rhinestone/dot effect on the primary text
Ensure the background is a solid, non-gradient color
Confirm the secondary text is a clean, legible sans-serif
recipe.reuseFormula: Group portrait + solid warm background + rhinestone display type + clean sans-serif subtitle = Y2K Pop Aesthetic.
